name: IP Scanner
description: IP Scanner is a network scanning tool for macOS that scans your local network to identify all connected devices and computers, displaying IP addresses, MAC addresses, and device names.

download.note: Vendor now ships via the Mac App Store; the old direct download is a beta-only build (IPScanner_6.0b3).

notes: Version via Mac App Store lookup (the product page carries no stable version string, only a macOS 26 beta link). Legacy non-MAS builds use bundle ID com.10baseT.IPScannerMacNMAS.
